newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT-Tsingtao estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Tsingtao estimates cut.

text.p: U.S. brokerage house Salomon Brothers said it has cut its 1996 earnings estimate for Tsingtao Brewery Co Ltd by 60 percent to 41.3 million yuan from the previous forecast of 104.9 million yuan.
Tsingtao is expected to announce its annual results for 1996 on Thursday. The company posted a 9.59 percent fall in earnings in 1995 to 97.79 million yuan.

"We believe management remains a major factor in determining the outlook of the company. Management has yet to formulate a long-term strategy to capitalise on the company's brand name," said analyst Pitzi Lau in a report dated April 17.
The brokerage estimates the Chinese brewery is trading at a 1997 price-earnings multiple of 32 times and 1998 multiple of 27 times.
"We believe the premium commanded by the stock is too high compared with the 11.7 times and nine times P/Es for the HSI (Hang Seng Index) for 1997 and 1998, respectively," said Lau.
Salomon said it was maintaining its underperform recommendation on the stock, but with a buy below HK$2.50.
Tsingtao shares dropped HK$0.35 to close at HK$3.40 on Wednesday.
